scripts.build:render: npm install && npm install --prefix server && python3 -m venv ml/venv && ml/venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ml/venv/bin/pip install -r ml/requirements.txt && npm run build
scripts.start:render: sh -c 'ml/venv/bin/python -m uvicorn ml.api:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 & exec node server/server.js'
